action: Kurly says it is notifying affected employees and former staff and the 2 customers individually. General advice: be alert to phishing that uses a name or email.
date_note: Dailysecu (21 November) says the external access happened on 17 November; Kurly reported it to the relevant agencies on 18 November and its CEO apologised on 20 November.
exec: A leak at a Korean online retailer of data on 10,699 curators, 199 current and former employees and 2 customers, including some curators' account and resident or business registration numbers.
geo_basis: country as stated (South Korea); Seoul used as the pin, city not stated in the source
plain: Korean online grocer Kurly says an outside attacker stole credentials and got into internal systems, leaking data of 10,699 curator-program participants, 199 current and former staff and 2 customers.
summary: Kurly said an external attacker accessed its system by an abnormal method on 17 November, stole credentials and entered internal business systems. Per Kurly, data of 10,699 curator-program participants and 2 general customers leaked, for some curators including account and resident or business registration numbers. On 23 November, Insight reports, Kurly said a full review also found names, departments and emails of 199 current and former employees leaked; Insight puts the total at 10,900.
title: Kurly says credentials stolen in 17 November intrusion; data of 10,699 curators, 199 staff and 2 customers leaked

validation.note: Dailysecu (21 Nov) and Insight (22 Nov) each relay Kurly's own statement of 20 November (17 Nov access, 18 Nov report to agencies, 10,699 curators and 2 general customers). Insight (23 Nov) alone relays Kurly's 23 November finding of 199 current and former employees and the 10,900 total. Kurly's own notice not read.

review.note: action advice: phishing warning was in no source; now Kurly's individual notice to 2 customers plus labelled General advice. Title, date, counts, data types, credential theft match Dailysecu and Insight.

evidence.quote: 지난 20일 컬리에 따르면 이번 사고로 개인정보가 유출된 대상은 큐레이터 프로그램 참여자 1만699명과 일반 고객 2명이다.
그러나 컬리는 주민등록번호와 계좌번호가 유출된 인원이 각각 몇 명인지는 밝히지 않았다.
임직원과 퇴직자 199명의 이름과 부서명, 이메일 주소가 유출됐다.
앞서 확인된 큐레이터 1만699명을 포함하면 이번 사고의 전체 개인정보 유출 피해자는 총 1만900명에 이른다.
